oot.unstable: {tool} failed {tries} times, each time in a different way (the last time with code {code}). The same step works on other computers with the same dump, so the memory of this process was damaged while it ran: that is what an unstable computer does, most often a processor or memory overclock (an XMP or EXPO profile too) or a 13th or 14th generation Intel Core i7 or i9 without the BIOS update for its voltage fault. Run the setup again; if it fails again, update the BIOS and try with the memory at its standard speed. Details: {log}

ui.oot_intro: Builds a native PC version of the game from your own dump: choose the folder with the dump, wait for the build, play. The build runs once and takes a while.
ui.oot_notice: The folder this setup builds contains the game. It is for your own use only; do not share or upload it. The dump stays where it is: the game reads its data from it.
ui.oot_pick_game: Choose the folder that holds your game dump
ui.oot_prompts_rekarina: Rekarina (Xbox names, the game's own button shapes)
ui.oot_dlls: Folder with your own DLSS / FSR libraries (optional)
ui.oot_pick_dlls: Choose a folder that holds nvngx_dlss.dll and the other upscaler libraries
ui.oot_dlls_help: Optional. The setup downloads the libraries your graphics card can use by itself, each from its maker's GitHub repository: AMD FSR 4.1 / 3.1 for every card (FidelityFX SDK, MIT License), NVIDIA DLSS for RTX cards and DLSS Frame Generation with Streamline for RTX 40 and newer (NVIDIA RTX SDKs License). A folder chosen here holds your own copies, which are used instead. Without any of them the game shows its sharp base picture with FSR 1.
ui.oot_textures_help: Converts the game's textures for your graphics card during the setup (about two minutes on a fast graphics card), so a place you see for the first time does not stutter while its textures are converted. Without it the game converts each texture the first time it appears and keeps it.
ui.oot_textures_space: {free} GB free on that drive: not enough for the game and all its textures (about {need} GB). The setup prepares the textures that fit and the game makes the rest while you play.

ui.oot_done_first_start: The first start of the game prepares the rest for your graphics card before play: about {minutes} min, once (and again after a graphics driver update). Leave this window open and the launcher does it in the background meanwhile; the first start is then that much shorter.
